intent: Test a slightly narrower wheel_track of 0.13 to improve turning agility further without losing stability, reduce sensor_size to 0.008 to enhance edge detection sharpness and reduce sensor overlap, and adjust sensor x-coordinates by ±0.005 to optimize sensor spacing and coverage. These changes aim to provide the controller with more precise sensor data and quicker physical response, potentially reducing off-track events and steering oscillations seen previously.
rationale: Integrator feedback and race telemetry indicate that the current geometry with wheel_track 0.14 and sensor_size 0.012 improved agility and sensor clarity but still left room for better steering precision and reduced oscillations. The integrator requested testing a narrower wheel_track (0.13) to gain more agility without sacrificing stability, a smaller sensor_size (0.008) to sharpen line edge detection and reduce sensor overlap, and adjusting sensor x-positions by ±0.005 to optimize sensor coverage. These changes should help the controller by providing clearer sensor signals and quicker turning capability, enabling better steering control and fewer off-track failures. The body length, width, mass, and wheel radius remain unchanged to maintain a stable baseline. I request measurements of completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, and line_loss_events to evaluate the impact of these geometry adjustments in the next race.
